title: OccupancySnapshot
description: One 30-minute snapshot of free-space counts for a single parking lot.

time.description: Snapshot timestamp in UTC (ISO 8601). Snapshots are roughly evenly spaced at 30-minute intervals with up to ~1 minute jitter.

free_spaces.description: Number of free spaces reported by the upstream API at this moment.

occupancy_rate.description: Percent (0–100) of *common* (non-accessible) spaces occupied at this moment, computed by the collector as (common_total - common_free) / common_total * 100, where common_total is the declared capacity for regular spaces only (excluding handicapped). NOTE: this is NOT 1 - free_spaces / total_spaces — that computation would also include handicapped spaces in the denominator. Use free_spaces / total_spaces for the all-inclusive ratio.
